description: Na₈TiO₆ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃cm space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.35 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.30 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.31 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.43 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.47 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. All Ti-O bond lengths are 1.84 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and three longer (1.85 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Ti atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃Ti tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Na atoms to form ONa₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₆ pentagonal pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₆ pentagonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Na atoms to form distorted ONa₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with six equivalent ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₆ pentagonal pyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₆ pentagonal pyramids and corners with three equivalent ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one Ti atom.
